subject: wrangler
detail: With a compatibility date of 2026-08-04 or later, to turn off Node.js compatibility completely, add both no_nodejs_compat and no_nodejs_compat_v2.

test.error: FAIL: a bare Node.js import did not build on compatibility date 2026-08-04 without nodejs_compat

source.quote: To turn off Node.js compatibility completely with a compatibility date of 2026-08-04 or later, remove the positive flags if present. Then add both no_nodejs_compat and no_nodejs_compat_v2.
